title: Monotonicity of the Work-Tape Bound
statement: Let $D$ be a multitape Turing machine, with starting state $q$, Boolean input word $V$, answer bit $b$, and natural-number bounds $B$ and $B'$. If $D$ has a run that halts with output exactly $[b]$, leaves every work-tape cell blank and every work-tape head at position zero, and keeps every work-tape head within absolute position $B$ at every time up to and including its halting time, then whenever $B\le B'$, it also has such a run with the bound $B'$.
hypotheses_covered: A clean run of $D$ on $V$ from $q$ with answer $b$ and bound $B$
